copy.headline: 10% of gross is the network OS — not a royalty on a dumb boat.
copy.body: The Navier network fee sits off the top of vessel revenue and funds the software and operating system that make four revenue layers runnable on one hull. Without it you are financing a boat; with it you are financing a network asset.

items.title: Fleet management software
items.body: Utilization, vessel state, scheduling, and day-to-day fleet control.

items.title: Experiences & charter management
items.body: Productize midday, evening, and private charters without a second ops stack.

items.title: Multichannel booking
items.body: Employer / campus plans, spot seats, and charter intake in one funnel.

items.title: Captain & crew app
items.body: Day-of operations, turnarounds, and checklists for the people running the boat.

items.title: Remote diagnostics
items.body: Uptime monitoring and maintenance planning before small issues become downtime.

items.title: OTA / continuous updates
items.body: Vessel software and apps keep improving after delivery — not a frozen hull.

items.title: Analytics & yield
items.body: Fill, pricing bands, and corridor performance so spare capacity earns.

items.title: Network playbook
items.body: Shared standards and redeployability across cities — residual value as a network asset.

copy.callout: 10% of gross, off the top → software + network ops that turn one N45 into a multi-layer earner.
